scenicChapters.narrative: 51 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Historic Centre of the City of Salzburg → Herrenchiemsee New Palace
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 66 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-abtsdorf-iii-herrenchiemsee-new-p.story: From Attersee it runs 234 km to Attersee; allow about 4 h 02 of riding. On the way it passes Historic Centre of the City of Salzburg, Herrenchiemsee New Palace and back through Historic Centre of the City of Salzburg. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses from Austria into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
